indexer_multi_leaf_root_repair.scope: Same fixed bank,128K/B24 submitted,observed peak21,64 output tokens; not192 or performance
indexer_multi_leaf_root_repair.diagnosed_module: Indexer multi-leaf pair-query fallback when active S6 request groups drop below4
root_cause: parallel leaves stored scores into the same contiguous query row
the long fallback did not publish pair_arena half roots that the downstream merge consumed
fix: use worker/query/AIV private score rows for multiple leaves
publish both half roots per leaf matching merge read addresses
guard incomplete query groups and initialize empty halves with negative infinity
